objective: Measure the full 42-layer coupled H512/H128 + suh/svh K4 P8 model against the full identity K4 P8 model on one image and one runtime configuration.

arm_definitions.coupled_full: layers 3..44 native P8, coupled boundary, sidecars from the full coupled build manifest; layers 3, 20, 22 reused from the pilot under the V3 design, the other 39 under the 42-layer design
arm_definitions.identity_full: layers 3..44 native P8, identity boundary, sidecars from the pinned uniform-p8-all42-v1 checkpoint re-measured on the same image

runtime.moe: native P8 mxf8f6f4 N128 small-M owner path, E4M3 UE8M0_K32 activations, no fused scratch
runtime.image: klc/glm53-p8-full-coupled:v10 (v9 sources plus a sitecustomize design-hash allowlist); the image id is bound in the runtime manifest at preparation

measurement.metric: KL(teacher || student), FP64 CPU, equal-window mean
measurement.exclusions: none; no rerolls; protected selection/confirmation/final roles stay closed

decision_rule.development: coupled_full mean true-decode KLD below identity_full; BCa reported, nonblocking
decision_rule.strict_claim: mean paired delta negative and paired BCa upper bound below zero
decision_rule.primary_comparison: coupled_full minus identity_full, same image, same runtime flags, same windows
report: exact bytes and bpw per arm

byte_accounting.note: coupled_full is 151,436,544 bytes (0.0936 %) larger than identity_full; it is not equal-size and is labelled as such

comparator_disclosure: The earlier identity full-model value 0.03730955956731441 was measured on klc/glm53-p8-tail-repair:v2 with FC1_TILE_N=64 and fused scratch; it is reported as context only. The matched control is identity_full re-measured on the v10 image with N128 and no fused scratch.
storage_policy: one raw capture at a time (1,268,157,440 bytes), durable score receipt before raw retirement; campaign apparent bytes plus one raw reservation must stay under the owner-approved ceiling bound in the execution seal
production_policy: klc-backend.service and klc-model-stack.timer stay inactive; port 8000 stays unbound; never restored by this campaign
claim_boundary: Already-opened CF32 development evidence, not final qualification. P8 mxf8f6f4 has twice the NVFP4 MMA issue count; no speed claim.
